prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Duck Rails maintenance depot layout study v1, proposed game environment, deliberately LOW RESOLUTION rough 3D concept render, target 1024px longest edge, simple chunky low-poly shapes and visibly coarse pixel textures, restrained detail, not polished cinematic art. Modern abandoned nighttime railway maintenance site, spooky but readable. Same spatial design in every view: single straight main railway runs south to north through center, train faces north. East/right side contains one rectangular corrugated repair shed with stepped/sawtooth roof, its long west facade facing railway with a wide open bay; repair stands and shelving create a walkable interior loop, second exit on south wall leads through a narrow outdoor service passage back to forecourt. Fenced work yard immediately north of shed, two broad openings toward track, sparse pallets and cable reels. West/left side has two separated small buildings facing railway: parts store to north and workshop to south, open loading space between them. Small open-deck teal train parked centrally. Generous unobstructed trackside boarding corridor, flat ground, no pits, no extra rail branches, no huge locomotive inside shed, no upstairs, no added gameplay mechanics. Six illustrative coal pickup points split three each side, avoid huge coal heaps. Cold isolated work lights, warm train lights, charcoal metal, dull concrete, muted teal, rusty trim. No characters necessary. This is an illustrative proposal, not a measured Unity render. View: elevated three-quarter overview from southwest looking northeast, show all four areas and relationship to parked train, shed opening clearly visible, low wooded horizon. Text only small title "MAINTENANCE DEPOT / ROUGH ARRIVAL STUDY".
